notes.title: NEW CONTROL + NEW LEVEL - available now!!
notes.content:
Hello friends (Sorry for bad english again).

Despite the fact that our game has bad reviews, we still do not despair and want to make it better.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31942288/028933cce083ca19bd8345b507c4d90916202a1e.png[/img]


-We noticed that the players did not like our control. We completely changed it.
  movement - left button
  zoom - wheel mouse
  take object or open something - the right button
We hope this control will like more.

- We added the first bonus level  "football"
To get into it you need to press a new button in the form of a star.
The bonus levels do not go to the basic levels and therefore do not affect the statistics.
They are just for fun)))
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31942288/6ef55a55fc5b3f4140678c3068c1caf5493e6f15.jpg[/img]
